doc.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Playing Billie's Bounce together
summary: Freeman and Coleman play the tune and a ballad, closing the tape.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Y’all ready? She just got set up.
Do you want to take it at a real mellow tempo?
Yeah. [Freeman sings the opening line.] We’ll play a chorus and then a couple fours, and then [?], because time is on me now. Eve, are you cool?
We’re not trying to rush you, Eve.

[starting just over seven minutes from the end of the tape, Freeman and Coleman play a five-minute version of Billie’s Bounce, playing the theme together once, trading solo choruses, trading four-bar phrases, and then playing the theme together again. They continue playing in a free-form ballad manner to the end of the tape.]
You weren’t playing Embraceable You, were you?
I don’t know. Something like that.
